messages:
emily: Heads-up - Jules handed in resignation today, final day 2026-11-12. Need owners for benefits end date, COBRA packet (US), licenses transfer, and access removal.

raj: I can do SSO and cloud creds. Please confirm any org-admin roles and repo admin rights.

jules: Laptop SN: RW-AP-5560. I have one GitHub deploy key and an API token for monitoring. Happy to add backups this week.

emily: Quick plan (please modify):
• create offboard ticket and inventory (People Ops)
• schedule exit interview and final payroll check (People Ops)
• disable SSO at 9am on last day, keep email 24h for payroll (Raj)
• revoke personal keys and rotate CI tokens (Raj + IT)
• rotate vault secrets and update rotation notes (IT)
• confirm device return method (drop at office or prepaid label) (People Ops)
• send COBRA packet and vendor link 2 business days before benefits end (People Ops)

jules: I added Jules-Backup to Sentry & CI today. Also will remove personal PATs before last day.

raj: I'll run an inventory sweep: `gh api /orgs/redwood/actions/secrets --jq '.[] | select(.created_by=="jules")'` and list any cloud service accounts. Will attach findings to ticket.

it-bot: Ticket created: HR-8422 - "Jules offboard: access, devices, COBRA". Assigned to Raj. ETA 1 business day. :white_check_mark:

emily: COBRA/benefits: coverage ends 2026-11-30 (EOM). Packet will go out 2026-11-28 with opt-in details and vendor contact. Also confirm PTO payout with payroll.

raj: Proposed on-last-day schedule: 09:00 disable SSO; 09:30 revoke keys/tokens; 10:00 remove from alerting/oncall; 10:30 rotate shared secrets.

emily: Please add any third-party sole-admins to the ticket. If Jules is sole admin anywhere, transfer before last day.

jules: Will compile list today and join exit call. Thanks all. :pray:
